questions.markdown:
A single-phase 230V, 50Hz source is connected to the following loads, which are connected in parallel.

a) 2000W, 0.707 lag
b) 1500 Var, 0.6 lag
Find the total current drawn by the loads. Also, determine the value of the capacitance to be connected across the loads, to improve the power factor to 0.95 lagging.

A 3-phase, 4-wire, 440V, 50Hz, RYB supply supplies a star-connected load with the phase impedances: $Z_R = Z_Y = Z_B = 6 + j8\ \Omega$. Taking $V_{RN}$ as reference, calculate,

a) Line currents
b) Neutral Current
c) Total active power
d) Draw the phasor diagram

Each of the two wattmeters connected to measure the input to a 3-phase circuit reads 20 kW. What does each instrument read when the load power factor is 0.866 lagging, with the total 3-phase power remaining unchanged?

A ring made of ferromagnetic material with a cross-sectional area of 10 cm$^2$ and a mean circumference of 40 cm is wound uniformly with a coil of 500 turns. Calculate the total reluctance and the current required to produce a flux density of 1.6 T in the air gap of length 2 mm. The relative permeability of the ferromagnetic material is 1000
